description: Three vertically stacked scatter plots of Young's modulus taken at different measurement rows. The top panel is labelled "Y=2", the middle "Y=1" and the bottom "Y=0". All three share the abscissa "Position X [μm]" (ticks 0, 5, 10, 15, 20) and the ordinate "Young's modulus E_r [GPa]", with dashed horizontal guide lines drawn at 100 and 200 GPa. Each panel plots three symbol series: solid magenta squares (highest), solid blue diamonds (intermediate) and open upright triangles (lowest). In the top panel two arrowed annotations read "R=50 μm" (pointing to the magenta-square series) and "R=200 μm" (pointing near the lower series). Across all rows the magenta squares sit in the region between the 200 and 300 GPa gridlines and drift slightly downward as X increases; the open triangles lie mostly between the 100 and 200 GPa lines and occasionally fall below 100 GPa. The same symbol ranking repeats for Y=0, 1 and 2, i.e. modulus varies with position and with distance from the grain boundary. No numeric data labels are printed on any point. Together the panels demonstrate a localized, position-dependent variation of elastic modulus near a grain boundary.

subfigures.description: Scatter plot of Young's modulus E_r [GPa] vs Position X [μm] for row Y=2. Three series (magenta squares, blue diamonds, open triangles) with arrowed annotations 'R=50 μm' and 'R=200 μm'. Dashed guide lines at 100 and 200 GPa.
Same scatter plot for row Y=1; same three symbol series and the same overall downward drift of modulus with Position X; guide lines at 100 and 200 GPa.
Same scatter plot for row Y=0; magenta squares highest, open triangles lowest, values falling with increasing Position X; guide lines at 100 and 200 GPa.

observations.observation: The figure is a stack of three scatter plots, labelled Y=2 (top), Y=1 (middle) and Y=0 (bottom).
All panels share the abscissa 'Position X [μm]' with tick labels 0, 5, 10, 15 and 20, and the ordinate 'Young's modulus E_r [GPa]'.
Dashed horizontal guide lines are drawn at 100 and 200 GPa in each panel.
Three symbol series are plotted in every panel: solid magenta squares, solid blue diamonds and open upright triangles.
In the top panel an arrow annotated 'R=50 μm' points to the magenta-square series.
In the top panel an arrow annotated 'R=200 μm' points toward the lower (blue-diamond/open-triangle) data.
The magenta squares are the highest-modulus series and the open triangles the lowest in all three rows.
Modulus values of the plotted series generally decrease as Position X increases from 0 towards about 15 μm in each row.
No numeric data values are printed on any plotted point; magnitudes can only be referenced to the 100 and 200 GPa gridlines.
The caption states the figure shows the 'Resulting Young's modulus near to the grain boundary'.
The citing text states the measurement region was recorded before CMP treatment and measured with an interval distance of 1 μm over 20 points in X and 3 points in Y.
